response.sql: WITH tel AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS tavg FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus HAVING AVG(s.pulsepersec) IS NOT NULL), st AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(tavg) AS savg FROM tel GROUP BY equipstatus), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean1 FROM st), k1 AS (SELECT st.equipstatus, st.savg, st.savg - m1.mean1 AS exc1 FROM st, m1 WHERE st.savg > m1.mean1), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(savg) AS mean2 FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.equipstatus, k1.savg, k1.exc1, k1.savg - m2.mean2 AS exc2 FROM k1, m2 WHERE k1.savg > m2.mean2) SELECT AVG(savg) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(exc1) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(exc2) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean FROM k2

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose signals all have NULL pulse rates have no telescope average and are excluded, so they do not count toward their status.
The mean of status averages is the unweighted mean across statuses. A NULL equipstatus, if present, is treated as its own group.
The 'remaining statuses' are those that pass both filters, meaning above the first mean and then above the second mean.
